name: OCHAG
source:
Hotspots are places where collective pain, hopes, and words left unsaid have gathered over the course of many years. Fractures in reality, infused with the emotions of those who lived there.

Can an old communal apartment behave as though it were alive? Or are these strange occurrences nothing more than coincidences?
